catalyst_only_route_definition: Gene__/UniProt__ regulatory intermediates, then exactly one annotated catalyst->Enzyme__->measured lipid product. No internal metabolites or reaction instances. This audit does not change scores or validate exact substrate specificity.
path_selection: One shortest path per reachable TF/observation pair; ties maximize minimum absolute inferred MOON score, then deterministic node-ID ordering. Level-0 weights excluded from this minimum.
illustration_selection: Three distinct downstream nodes ordered by absolute Factor 1 weight; for each choose greatest minimum absolute inferred score, then shortest path, then TF ID.
limitations: Paths are qualitative directed hypotheses, not causal identification or flux predictions.
LINEX2_rule species reactions transfer a generic class reaction to the reported chains; source references do not establish the exact measured substrate specificity.
A shortest path omits alternative routes and is an auditable example, not an optimal mechanistic explanation.
Scoring layer depth does not cap the length of every directed TF/observation route in the union graph; exact edge counts are reported.
Protein node scores reflect activity hypotheses; they are not measurements of protein abundance.
Level-0 Factor 1 weights and inferred MOON scores are distinct quantities and should not be compared numerically.
